entity_level_taxes.name: Corporation franchise tax
entity_level_taxes.notes: 0.3% of Arkansas-apportioned outstanding capital stock, minimum $150 (stock corporations), due May 1 with the annual report to the Secretary of State.

pte_elective_tax.rate_note: Elective pass-through entity tax (Act 362 of 2021, Form AR362 election, AR1100PET return) at the top individual marginal rate (3.7% for 2026 after Act 2 of 2026 1st Extraordinary Session; 2026 PET instructions not yet read), capital gains at half the rate.

sources.title: Annual Corporation Franchise Tax Report 2026 (via search index)
Pass-Through Entity-Level Tax: Frequently Asked Questions (DFA)
sources.quote: The net taxable income of the affected business entity is taxed at the top marginal income-tax rate under § 26-51-201(a)(2).

personal_exemption.notes: Personal tax credit $29 per taxpayer ($58 joint) plus $29 per dependent. Brackets shown apply when net income is $94,700 or less. Above $94,700: 2% on the first $4,700 and 3.7% on the rest, minus a bracket adjustment ($290 down to $10) for net income $94,701-$97,600. The same table applies to every filing status (spouses may file separately on the same return). Standard deduction is $2,470 per taxpayer ($4,940 joint inferred from 'per taxpayer').

estimated_tax.required_if: You can reasonably expect your estimated tax to be more than $1,000
estimated_tax.notes: Must pay at least 90% of the tax actually due; penalty 10% per year on the underestimate.

unemployment_2026.notes: 2026: new employer rate 2.0% (in 2025 this was 1.9% plus 0.1% administrative assessment); experienced range 0.2%-5.1%.

notable: Top income tax rate cut from 3.9% to 3.7% for 2026, enacted in May 2026 (Act 2, 1st Extraordinary Session) and applied retroactively to January 1, 2026; DFA updated its 2026 withholding formula (https://www.arkleg.state.ar.us/Home/FTPDocument?path=%2FACTS%2F2026S1%2FPublic%2FACT2.pdf)
Every LLC pays a flat $150 franchise tax each May 1, with no extensions (https://www.sos.arkansas.gov/uploads/bcs/LLC1_FT_2026.pdf)
Arkansas does not start from federal AGI and uses a tiny standard deduction ($2,470) plus $29 personal credits (https://www.dfa.arkansas.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026_Final_AR1000ES_2.pdf)
uncertain: Arkansas income above $94,700 uses a different table (2% on first $4,700, 3.7% above, less bracket adjustment); a calculator using only the bracket list will slightly overstate tax for high incomes. The withholding formula's 'minus adjustment' column handles this.
MFJ standard deduction $4,940 inferred from '$2,470 per taxpayer'.
PTE tax rate for 2026 assumed to follow the 3.7% top rate; 2026 PET instructions not published/read.
Corporation franchise tax 0.3% / $150 minimum read via search index of the 2026 SOS form, not the PDF directly.
